notes.title: Step quietly into madness with 2Dark, now available on Steam!
notes.content:
If you’re into challenging gameplay and the thrill of a good survival-horror game, then 2Dark should be right up your street. 
[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/2sal6w3.png[/IMG]
Welcome to Gloomywood, a once-picturesque town plagued by a recent series of kidnappings. You take on the role of Mr. Smith, a former detective who saw his life turned upside down one fateful night: his wife brutally murdered and his children abducted. After losing everything he held dear, he vowed to find the ones responsible and he thinks these new abductions may just be the lead he was looking for all along.
Now it is on you to help him rescue the kids from the claws of bloodthirsty psychopaths. Do you have the patience and skill to delve deep into the lion’s lair and free the children without being spotted? 
Check out our Launch Trailer, to get a glimpse at the darkness that awaits you! ;) 
https://youtu.be/xSe4cPQP8Yw
